body.title: fix: support "--security-opt systempaths=unconfined" in container options (#1794)
body.body:
mergo doesn't really seem to handle this "non-nil but empty slice" thing very well, so I've written a test and special cased the MaskedPaths and ReadOnlyPaths as a post-merge check. I believe systempaths=unconfined is the only option that behaves this way. I added the PidsLimit, which worked before, to the test as well.
